en: The postcard is in black-and-white and shows a quiet residential street lined with villas, trees, and fences. The street is labeled as 'Sundsvall. Östra Esplanadgatan.' The reverse side has handwritten text in Swedish, a 10 öre Swedish stamp featuring a lion and labeled 'SVERIGE,' and is addressed to Herr C. G. Isaksson, Nybygget, Sävsjö. The card also contains a handwritten message.
